title: Applied Materials forecasts revenue above estimates, shares fall on high expectations
excerpt: Applied Materials forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations on Thursday, betting that unabated demand for advanced AI ‌chips will contin...
content_html:
By Juby Babu

Aug 13 (Reuters) - Applied Materials forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street expectations on Thursday, betting that unabated demand for advanced AI ‌chips will continue to fuel robust spending on its semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

Even ‌so, its shares dropped more than 5% in extended trading as lofty investor expectations overshadowed the results. ​The stock has more than doubled this year.

Expectations are elevated as the chip equipment maker reports after peers Lam Research and KLA posted solid quarterly performances and forecast revenue growth, Stifel's Brian Chin said.

According to CFRA analyst Brooks Idlet, the results and the ‌forecast were not enough to ⁠impress the Street, but the print was still solid as momentum clearly continues to improve. "We think calendar year 2027 consensus estimates ⁠leave room for upside if recent strength continues."

Applied Materials, which supplies equipment used in key wafer fabrication processes including deposition, chemical mechanical planarization and inspection, is benefiting from increased ​spending by ​chipmakers to support a rapid build-out of ​AI infrastructure.

It forecast fourth-quarter revenue of ‌around $10.25 billion, plus or minus $500 million, compared with analysts' average estimate of $9.54 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.

"We expect continued strong revenue growth in the second half of the calendar year, particularly in DRAM as well as leading-edge foundry-logic and advanced packaging," Chief Financial Officer Brice Hill said.

Applied expects overall packaging revenue to grow ‌more than 70% in calendar year 2026, ahead ​of its prior projection of over 50%.

"Customers continue ​to give us longer visibility ​than we have ever had, with some conversations now extending to ‌2030," Hill said on a post-earnings ​call.

For the fourth quarter, ​Applied expects adjusted profit per share of $4.02, plus or minus 20 cents, compared with the estimate of $3.69.

It sees adjusted gross margin of 50.4%, versus analysts' ​expectations of 50.15% and in ‌line with the third quarter.

Revenue for the quarter ended July 26 ​grew 25% to $9.12 billion, surpassing the estimate of $8.99 billion.

(Reporting by Juby Babu ​in Mexico City; Editing by Shilpi Majumdar)

content_html_zh:
作者：朱比·巴布

路透 8 月 13 日 - 应用材料公司周四预测第四季度营收将高于华尔街预期，并押注对先进 AI 芯片的不减需求将继续推动其半导体制造设备的强劲支出。

即便如此，由于投资者的高期望掩盖了业绩，该公司股价在盘后交易中仍下跌了 5% 以上。今年该股股价上涨了一倍多。

Stifel 的 Brian Chin 表示，在同行 Lam Research 和 KLA 公布稳健的季度业绩并预测收入增长后，芯片设备制造商的预期有所提高。

CFRA 分析师 Brooks Idlet 表示，结果和预测不足以给华尔街留下深刻印象，但随着势头明显持续改善，结果仍然稳固。 “我们认为，如果近期的强势持续下去，2027 年的共识预测将留下上涨空间。”

应用材料公司供应沉积、化学机械平坦化和检测等关键晶圆制造工艺中使用的设备，该公司受益于芯片制造商为支持人工智能基础设施快速建设而增加的支出。

根据 LSEG 汇编的数据，该公司预计第四季度营收约为 102.5 亿美元，上下浮动 5 亿美元，而分析师平均预期为 95.4 亿美元。

首席财务官 Brice Hill 表示：“我们预计下半年收入将持续强劲增长，特别是在 DRAM 以及领先的代工逻辑和先进封装领域。”

应用材料公司预计 2026 年整体封装收入将增长 70% 以上，高于之前预测的 50% 以上。

希尔在财报后电话会议上表示：“客户继续为我们提供比以往任何时候都更长的可见性，一些对话现在已延长至 2030 年。”

对于第四季度，Applied 预计调整后每股利润为 4.02 美元，上下浮动 20 美分，而预期为 3.69 美元。

预计调整后毛利率为 50.4%，高于分析师预期的 50.15%，与第三季度的情况一致。

截至 7 月 26 日的季度收入增长 25%，达到 91.2 亿美元，超过预期的 89.9 亿美元。

（Juby Babu 墨西哥城报道；Shilpi Majumdar 编辑）
